ambiguity_flags.note: Unrecognized proposed term with unresolvable concept mapping. Depending on reader context, 'truth_store' could denote the full Layer-2 architectural boundary (LAYER_2), the published snapshot as the source of downstream truth (SNAPSHOT_TRUTH), or the raw observations database (OBSERVATIONS). This tri-way ambiguity is governance-critical: downstream consumers classifying claims against 'truth_store' cannot determine which snapshot-boundary, ingestion-pipeline, or publication rules apply. Fail-closed per CLAUDE.md Section 7: adoption blocked pending disambiguation.

Unrecognized proposed term with unresolvable concept mapping. 'decision_layer' could denote the full planned Layer-3 multi-stage architecture (LAYER_3), the DecisionPacket output schema (DECISION_PACKET), or the NO_TRADE signal routing logic (NO_TRADE). Collapsing a multi-component planned architecture into a singular 'layer' label risks weakening phase-gate enforcement (CLAUDE.md Section 4) and violating strong-claim discipline (Section 10): a 'decision_layer' that sounds implemented could enable forbidden claims that 'decisions are automated'. Fail-closed per CLAUDE.md Section 7: adoption blocked pending disambiguation.
